title: Relevance AI alternatives for sales teams | 50agents
description: Relevance AI alternatives: Lindy for a rep's inbox, Gumloop for team AI agents, n8n to self-host, Zapier Agents, and 50agents for follow-up drafts.
answer: Lindy works in a rep's inbox and calendar; Gumloop builds shared team AI agents.
n8n self-hosts, Zapier adds AI agents to workflows, and 50agents drafts follow-ups for your approval, free to start.
line: Follow-ups drafted by an AI agent, sent only after you approve.
ask: Set up an AI agent that finds my HubSpot deals with no reply in 5 days every weekday at 9:00 and drafts a follow-up email for me to approve
lede: Options for sales teams, with what each is best for.

strengths.title: AI agents that decide
strengths.line: Each run, an AI agent works from your instructions and connected apps.

strengths.title: You approve what goes out
strengths.line: Emails to clients wait in Needs you until you say yes.

strengths.title: It knows your business
strengths.line: Hours, prices, policies and tone, remembered once and used in every reply.

move.title: Pick one sales task
move.body: For example: follow up on HubSpot deals with no reply in 5 days.

move.title: Describe it to Captain
move.body: Captain connects HubSpot, shows the plan and builds it.

move.title: Approve each draft
move.body: Follow-ups wait in Needs you. Approve, change or decline each one.

move.title: Add the next task
move.body: Move one task at a time until the old setup has nothing left to do.

faqs.q: Does Relevance AI have a free plan?
faqs.a: No. Relevance AI retired its free plan. Pro is $19 a month billed yearly, or $29 billed monthly, for 2,500 actions.

faqs.q: Which alternative suits a small sales team?
faqs.a: If replies need a human check, 50agents drafts follow-ups and waits for your yes. Lindy suits one rep's inbox and calendar.

faqs.q: How many integrations does Relevance AI have?
faqs.a: Relevance AI states 2,000+ integrations. 50agents works with 2,300+ apps through viaSocket.
